Love Live!

Hasunosora Jogakuin School Idol Club Link Live Dream ~106th Class New Member Welcoming Concert~

Information on the concert welcoming the newest class of Hasunosora members on 2027 Jan 22.

Official website: https://www.lovelive-anime.jp/hasunosora/live-event/live_detail.php?p=LLDream106

Basic Info

  • When: 2027-01-22 (Friday), Doors 16:00 / Starts 17:00
  • Venue: Nippon Budokan
  • Cast: Nirei Nozomi (Kaho), Nonaka Kokona (Sayaka), Sasaki Kotoko (Tsuzuri), Kan Kanna (Rurino), Tsukine Kona (Megumi), Sakurai Hina (Ginko), Hayama Fuka (Kosuzu), Kurusu Rin (Hime), Miyake Miu (Ceras), Shindo Amane (Izumi)
  • And the new cast: Hoshimiya Julia (Maika), Asahi Kana (Aoi), Yuasa Kanae (Mion)

In-person Tickets

To obtain a ticket to attend, you (usually) must enter a lottery, and if you win you'll get to pay for the ticket. If there are still tickets left after all the lottery rounds, there may be first-come-first-serve sales.

Ticketing for most Love Live! events are on the e+ website. Click here for a guide to ticket applications on e+. (If you applied for tickets before 2020, some things have changed, so you may want to read this.)

More details will be announced later.
